stories.title: Cluster Routing Configuration Schema
stories.description: Define and validate a strict configuration schema for multi-cluster MongoDB routing including: cluster registry, environment-to-cluster mapping (dev/qa/prod), read/write intent flags, and deny-by-default rules. Enforce schema validation at startup with fail-fast behavior.

stories.title: Core Cluster Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement deterministic routing resolver that selects the correct MongoDB cluster based on environment, operation type (read/write), and service context. Include hard guards preventing cross-cluster access and explicit error paths for undefined routes.

stories.title: Governed Connection Access Layer
stories.description: Create a single enforced connection factory interface that all services must use. Block direct Mongo client instantiation, validate routing decisions at runtime, and emit structured audit logs for cluster selection and violations.

stories.title: Service Integration with Governed Routing
stories.description: Refactor all MongoDB-consuming components (provider search, embeddings, debug logger, pipelines, facades) to exclusively use the governed connection layer. Remove legacy connection paths and verify no bypass remains.

stories.title: Routing Validation and Failure Mode Tests
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering: correct cluster selection, enforcement of deny rules, environment isolation, prevention of cross-cluster reads/writes, and behavior under misconfiguration or cluster unavailability. Validate audit log emission.
